aboutHeadline: The same rigor, from sports to data.
aboutP1: As an endurance sports enthusiast, I approach the world of data with the same methodology: patience, strategy, and attention to detail. Extracting relevant information from a complex dataset requires the same concentration as a long-distance race.
aboutP2: Currently studying ”Data Administration, Management, and Exploitation,“ I am training to transform raw data into informed decisions. I am developing skills in database administration, data analysis, and Big Data technologies.
edu1School: University Savoie Mont-Blanc, IUT of Annecy
edu1Desc: Specialization in 'Data Administration, Management, and Operations'. Currently in second year.
edu2Desc: Information and Digital Systems (SIN) option. Graduated with High Honors.

project1Subtitle: My group and I created a game with the constraint word “chicken.” The farmer must catch as many chickens as possible without being touched by infected chickens.
project2Subtitle: My group and I redesigned the inventory management website for Nicolas, a wine retailer. We designed the UML and drafted the specifications. We then developed the code, linking it to an existing database.
project3Subtitle: I designed my portfolio myself, a personal website intended to showcase my profile and skills. I included various sections (about me, education, experience, projects) to highlight my career path.
project4Subtitle: My team and I designed and developed the site, following the entire implementation cycle: modeling (BPMN, MCD/MLD), database creation with test sets, then programming and implementation of features.
project5Subtitle: As part of a university project, my team and I designed a database based on an identified need. After completing the MCD and MPD, we developed the SQL script and created datasets to test the consistency of the model. Finally, we presented the results using Power BI, which allowed us to highlight the information using clear and interactive dashboards.
project6Subtitle: As part of a university project, my team and I designed an installation guide for the Ubuntu Mate 20.04 VM.
